crossRefs.note: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you. Yes, who doesn’t know such things as these?
“Surely I would speak to the Almighty. I desire to reason with God.
Hear now my reasoning. Listen to the pleadings of my lips.
Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power…
Where then does wisdom come from? Where is the place of understanding?
Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the birds of the sky.
“Who is this who darkens counsel by words without knowledge?
You asked, ‘Who is this who hides counsel without knowledge?’ therefore I have uttered that which I didn’t understand…
When I tried to understand this, it was too painful for me,
until I entered God’s sanctuary, and considered their latter end.
I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.
This knowledge is beyond me. It’s lofty. I can’t attain it.
“Surely I am the most ignorant man, and don’t have a man’s understanding.
For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was…
Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we…

translations.web: Teach us what we will tell him, for we can’t make our case by reason of darkness.
translations.bsb: Teach us what we should say to Him; we cannot draw up our case because of our darkness.
translations.kjv: Teach us what we shall say unto him; for we cannot order our speech by reason of darkness.
translations.asv: Teach us what we shall say unto him; For we cannot set our speech in order by reason of darkness.
